name: graph-first-test-fqn-repoint
body: `requirements.note.graph-first-test-pending` reaches the graph-first coherence test `rust.main_e2e.e2e.graph_first_rule_stated_in_navigator_prompt_and_guide` (path `tests/main_e2e.rs`) through its `details` edge, and reaches `requirements.requirement.graph-first-navigation` through a second `details` edge. The test FQN is language-rooted in the branch graph. A `details` edge refuses a Note-to-Note target, so a reconciliation note attaches to the requirement it serves.
